verdict.rationale: Unleash supports reviewing changes via Change Requests (approval workflow before changes go live) and RBAC to control who can make changes, which partially covers 'review' of automation-like flag configurations. However, there is no evidence of explicit version history tracking or a documented rollback mechanism (e.g., reverting to a prior flag configuration state) beyond manually toggling strategies or disabling a flag. Missing for 10: explicit flag/version history, audit trail, and a documented one-click rollback feature.
